description:
Get full details for one listed app by slug.

Use when: you already have an app slug (from search_apps, latest_apps or get_vibe50) and need its source link, website, builder, stack or stated revenue.

Behavior: Read-only. Returns the app record, or isError with code not_found if the slug is unknown or not live.

Example: {"slug":"stella"}
name: get_app
title: Get one app
